# Mizan

> Mizan gives Muslims a personalized, sourced plan to quit watching pornography, grounded in the Qur'an and the Sunnah, delivered as a private daily page after a small one time payment.

Mizan is not an app and not a forum. A visitor answers a few short questions
about their own situation, pays $5 once, and gets a private 14 day plan: one
real step each day, built from how the previous day actually went, each step
sourced with a verified citation from the Qur'an or an authentic hadith.

## Key facts
- Audience: Muslims trying to stop watching pornography or masturbating.
- Approach: daily, personalized, sourced from Qur'an and Sunnah. Never generic advice.
- Price: $5 one time for the full 14 days.
- Privacy: fully anonymous. Nothing is posted or shared. Contact is by Instagram DM or email.
- Contact: https://instagram.com/mizan.guide

## Pages
- [Start a plan](https://mizanguide.github.io/mizan_guide/): the intake questions, the paywall, and the FAQ.

## Questions this site directly answers
- How do I quit porn addiction as a Muslim?
- Why can't I stop watching porn even though I know it's haram?
- Is watching porn haram in Islam?
- Is masturbation haram in Islam?
- Is nofap sunnah, or just a secular trend?
- Do I need ghusl after watching porn?
- Will Allah forgive me for watching porn?
- How many times will Allah forgive me for the same sin?
- What can I say when the urge comes?
- How does Mizan help someone quit?
